description: payment-api: HTTP 503 spike after v2.7.9 deployed.
logs: level=ERROR service=payment-api message="Timeout acquiring database connection"
root_cause: Checkout exception path left database connections unclosed
failed_approaches: Increasing pool size only delayed exhaustion
postmortem: Add exception-path connection-release tests and track checked-out connection age.

description: payment-api: HTTP 503 errors after v2.8.1 payment tracing enabled.
logs: level=ERROR service=payment-api message="Timeout acquiring database connection"
root_cause: Tracing wrapper skipped connection close on cancelled requests
failed_approaches: Database failover did not fix the client leak
postmortem: Test cancellation cleanup and require connection-lifecycle review for wrappers.

description: order-service: Database pool saturated after batch importer concurrency increased.
logs: level=ERROR service=order-service message="Timeout acquiring database connection"
root_cause: Unbounded importer parallelism consumed the shared database pool
failed_approaches: Adding API replicas increased database pressure
postmortem: Separate batch and interactive connection budgets and cap importer concurrency.

description: inventory-service: Cache latency high after bulk cache warm started.
logs: level=ERROR service=inventory-service message="Redis command timed out after 2000ms"
root_cause: Cache warm job issued a blocking KEYS scan against production Redis
failed_approaches: Restarting API pods did not remove Redis blocking work
postmortem: Ban KEYS in production jobs and monitor Redis slowlog.

description: auth-service: 401 errors for valid users after signing key rotated.
logs: level=ERROR service=auth-service message="JWT signature verification failed"
root_cause: Verifier key cache did not include the newly active signing key
failed_approaches: Clearing user cookies could not fix server key mismatch
postmortem: Use overlapping rotation windows and a canary token validation check.

description: notification-service: Emails delayed after email provider rate limit reduced.
logs: level=ERROR service=notification-service message="Consumer lag 180000 messages"
root_cause: Workers retried throttled requests without backoff
failed_approaches: Increasing workers worsened provider throttling
postmortem: Honor Retry-After and alert on lag age rather than only queue size.

description: order-service: HTTP 500 on checkout after application deployed before migration.
logs: level=ERROR service=order-service message="Column delivery_slot does not exist"
root_cause: New application queried a column before the compatible schema migration ran
failed_approaches: Restarting instances could not create the missing column
postmortem: Gate application rollout on backward-compatible migration completion.

description: payment-api: External payments time out after egress policy updated.
error_message: TLS handshake timeout to payment gateway
logs: level=ERROR service=payment-api message="TLS handshake timeout to payment gateway"
root_cause: Egress policy omitted a payment gateway endpoint
failed_approaches: Increasing database pool size had no relevance
postmortem: Test each gateway endpoint before activating network policies.

description: inventory-service: CPU 98 percent after sku validation regex changed.
logs: level=ERROR service=inventory-service message="Request processing deadline exceeded"
root_cause: Pathological regular expression backtracking on long SKU inputs
failed_approaches: Adding CPU capacity masked but did not remove the pathological input
postmortem: Require bounded validation and worst-case input tests.

description: auth-service: RSS grows over hours after session diagnostics enabled.
logs: level=ERROR service=auth-service message="OOMKilled exit code 137"
root_cause: Diagnostic event buffer had no size bound
failed_approaches: Raising memory limits extended the interval between crashes
postmortem: Bound diagnostic buffers and run a memory soak test.

description: notification-service: Heap increases after attachment batch limit raised.
logs: level=ERROR service=notification-service message="Java heap space"
root_cause: Workers loaded entire batches of attachments into heap
failed_approaches: Restart alone caused the same failure on replay
postmortem: Apply byte-based batch limits and use streaming uploads.

description: order-service: 503 at gateway after readiness path changed.
logs: level=ERROR service=order-service message="Upstream has no healthy endpoints"
root_cause: Gateway health check still referenced the retired readiness path
failed_approaches: Scaling pods did not correct the route mismatch
postmortem: Keep health endpoints backward compatible during rollout.

description: inventory-service: Consumer lag climbing after bulk stock event enabled.
logs: level=ERROR service=inventory-service message="Rebalance in progress"
root_cause: Processing large batches exceeded max poll interval
resolution_steps: Tuned poll interval within latency budget
failed_approaches: More consumers caused additional rebalance churn
postmortem: Load-test worst-case batch processing time against poll interval.

description: auth-service: Login session reads fail after redis credentials rotated.
logs: level=ERROR service=auth-service message="NOAUTH Authentication required"
root_cause: Application secret mount still referenced the previous credential version
failed_approaches: Redis restart did not update client credentials
postmortem: Validate secret propagation in a canary before credential rotation.

description: payment-api: 503 errors after settlement reconciliation query changed.
logs: level=ERROR service=payment-api message="Timeout acquiring database connection"
root_cause: Long-running settlement transaction blocked checkout writes and held connections
failed_approaches: Rolling API alone did not release the database blocker
postmortem: Set statement timeouts and test settlement queries with checkout load.

description: notification-service: New workers pending after release tag was not published.
logs: level=ERROR service=notification-service message="ImagePullBackOff"
root_cause: Deployment referenced a missing immutable image tag
failed_approaches: Repeated rollout retries could not fetch an absent image
postmortem: Verify image digest exists before deploying workers.

description: order-service: Request latency high after verbose response field enabled.
logs: level=ERROR service=order-service message="CPU throttling above 80 percent"
root_cause: Repeated serialization of a large product payload exhausted CPU budget
failed_approaches: Raising request timeout increased backlog
postmortem: Benchmark serialization cost for new response fields.

description: inventory-service: Intermittent dependency failures after resolver configuration rolled out.
logs: level=ERROR service=inventory-service message="DNS resolution timed out"
root_cause: Resolver search suffix configuration generated excessive DNS queries
failed_approaches: Restarting downstream database did not affect DNS
postmortem: Canary DNS configuration and measure query amplification.

description: auth-service: External login 503 after identity provider maintenance.
logs: level=ERROR service=auth-service message="Identity provider unavailable"
root_cause: Upstream identity provider outage exceeded retry budget
failed_approaches: Unlimited retries amplified request load
postmortem: Use bounded retries and communicate external login degradation; full recovery was not confirmed.

description: payment-api: Intermittent gateway timeouts after no application deployment.
logs: level=ERROR service=payment-api message="Gateway request deadline exceeded"
root_cause: Confirmed packet loss on upstream transit path; provider repair pending
failed_approaches: Increasing application timeout did not eliminate packet loss
postmortem: Do not blindly retry non-idempotent payment operations; provider follow-up remains open.
